title: Survey the Ice Tunnels
story: The ice has split the tunnel network into pockets. Survey every pocket before restoring radio coverage.
lesson: DFS visits one connected region with a stack. After draining it, find the next unvisited open cell. Count the size of each region.
objective: Return sizes of all cardinally connected '.' regions, sorted largest first. '#' cells are blocked.
hint: Maintain visited across all searches. Start a new stack at every unseen '.'.
